changes: Added fail-closed versioned impact classification, bounded incremental review basis selection, signed Prompt Envelope binding, production escalation, budget separation, documentation, and adversarial regression coverage.
usage: Call review_incremental_context for a Story; consume incremental context only when eligibility is explicit and fresh, otherwise follow the stable reason code and run full review.
expectedOutcome: Safe fixture-only or metadata-only changes can receive bounded incremental review context, while ambiguous, stale, policy-sensitive, documentation, schema, or authority changes deterministically escalate to full review.
actualTranscript: All four milestones and 36 verification intents passed; three rounds across two hosts reached full-3x2 assurance, all four reviewer lanes passed the final round, and routine validation completed successfully.
outcomeDiff: No material difference: observed behavior matches the expected fail-closed eligibility and escalation contract.
limitations: Version 1 intentionally permits only no-material metadata changes and exactly bound pure fixture deltas; broader categories remain full-review by design.
pitfalls: Initial review exposed self-invalidating review basis, missing production escalation, duplicate fixture identity overwrite, and stale documentation; two repair rounds fixed them. Future extensions must remain versioned and fail closed.
